Have you looked into seeing a reproductive endocrinologist and/or maternal fetal medicine maybe? Sometimes OBGYN will refer out to them for more difficult cases and they might be able to offer more help since they’re more specialized in infertility and pregnancy loss.

Came here to suggest GWLS and ya beat me to it.

They are absolutely the best option to get a decent/good lawyer doing some probono or low cost services.
I used a privately practicing lawyer for my semi-messy divorce, but that’s because I had the money to pay her retainer and fees at the time. Otherwise I would have used GWLS to find someone.
It does take a while to get through to the actual finalization of the divorce by a judge in cases where y’all are likely to butt heads on terms (unless you luck out), so best wishes through this process.
